CREATE TABLE "public"."query_search_builder" (
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "city" text,
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "experience" text NOT NULL,
  "hash" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "keywords" text[] NOT NULL,
  "locationRegion" text NOT NULL,
  "params" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "technologies" text[] NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_channel_check_687325cb" CHECK ("channel" IN ('LINKEDIN_JOB_BOARD', 'LINKEDIN_POSTS', 'GREEN_HOUSE', 'ASHBY')),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_experience_check_da85d416" CHECK ("experience" IN ('junior', 'mid', 'senior', 'staff', 'lead', 'principal', 'unstated')),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_keywords_elem_not_null_f10c6f3f" CHECK (array_position("keywords", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_locationRegion_check_eb30a260" CHECK ("locationRegion" IN ('EMEA', 'MENA', 'NORTH_AFRICA', 'SUB_SAHARAN_AFRICA', 'MIDDLE_EAST', 'EUROPE', 'EU', 'UK', 'NORTH_AMERICA', 'LATAM', 'APAC', 'GLOBAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_technologies_check_84960705" CHECK (array_remove("technologies", NULL) <@ '{"javascript","typescript","python","java","kotlin","go","rust","csharp","cpp","php","ruby","scala","elixir","swift","dart","sql","bash","nodejs","nestjs","express","fastify","django","fastapi","flask","spring","dotnet","laravel","rails","graphql","grpc","react","nextjs","vue","nuxt","angular","svelte","tailwindcss","react_native","flutter","postgresql","mysql","mongodb","redis","elasticsearch","kafka","rabbitmq","spark","airflow","dbt","snowflake","aws","gcp","azure","docker","kubernetes","terraform","ansible","github_actions","gitlab_ci","linux","nginx","prometheus","grafana","pytorch","tensorflow","langchain"}'),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_technologies_elem_not_null_89b37e18" CHECK (array_position("technologies", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "query_search_builder_type_check_21429531" CHECK ("type" IN ('remote', 'hybrid', 'onsite', 'unstated'))
)
